attributes.check1: Intelligence or Arcane or Wisdom or Divine 12
attributes.name: Bound Shadow Demon
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to examine the top card of a location deck. If it is a boon, you may additionally bury this card to encounter it; add 1d12 to your checks to acquire it. If it is a monster that is not immune to the Mental trait, you may additionally bury this card to put it on the bottom of the location deck.

After playing this card, you may succeed at an Arcane or Divine 14 check to recharge this card instead of burying it.

If this card is in your hand, you may treat it as a monster.
